title: The DECISION: founders bring a live decision to Eric and a panel
summary: Three Midwest founders each get fifteen minutes to put a real decision, with their data and goals, to Eric and a panel of advisers. Applications close on 10 December and anyone can watch; the session is recorded.
attribution_title: The DECISION · Thursday 7 January 2027, 1:00–2:00 PM EST · online
blockquote: AI has made building and measuring easier, learning and deciding harder. For that reason we bring you "The DECISION" with Eric Ries
